description: President Emmanuel Macron on Friday said he had ordered measures to shield France's key infrastructure and defence industry sites from increasing Russian hybrid attacks. The announcement came as Macron spoke to the press after meeting in Paris with political party leaders to discuss recent developments in the international situation including the wars in the Middle East and Ukraine. Watch his press conference in full above.

title: Russian elections: 'Even the facade of opposition has gone'
description: Russians on Friday began three days of voting in the country’s first wartime parliamentary election, which features virtually no opposition and is all but certain to secure the Kremlin’s political dominance. France 24's Douglas Herbert takes a closer look.

title: Ms. Rachel matches Macklemore’s $1m Palestine donation
description: DUBAI: US children’s entertainer Ms. Rachel said on Thursday she would match a $1 million donation by American rapper Macklemore to Palestinian aid groups, days after he was dropped from Ed Sheeran’s Loop Tour over pro-Palestine remarks on stage. “I will match Macklemore’s donation and I invite every wealthy white celebrity to match it and speak out against the genocide in Gaza,” Ms. Rachel, whose real name is Rachel Accurso, said on Instagram. “
